name: SCHOOLBOY SIM
description:
You’re grounded again — this time under lock and key. Your parents have turned the house into a fortress: your mom stalks the second floor, your dad guards the first, and every attempt to slip out could end in humiliating punishments. But in SCHOOLBOY SIM, every locked door hides a puzzle, every patrol can be outsmarted, and freedom is always just one clever step away.

The game drops you straight into a cinematic storyline: your mom storms in, hands down your punishment, and locks you inside. From that moment, your mission begins — find the codes, beat the patrols, and escape before the night is over.

Features:
• Outsmart your parents and learn their patrol patterns.
• Solve puzzles that unlock doors, codes, and secret paths.
• Use stealth and timing to sneak past danger.
• Piece together clues leading to your ultimate escape.

No handholding — only hints. Every move is a risk, every success a step closer to freedom. SCHOOLBOY SIM turns a simple punishment into a tense, cinematic escape adventure.
